The '''Nightmare Lands''' were a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Voss]].

==Overview==
The overgrowth in the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] was said to be dense, and the forest was under the sway of a corrupt influence. The region was inhabited by wildlife that had been tainted, [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] natives who had been corrupted, and [[Voss Mystics]]&mdash;members of the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] species&mdash;who had gone mad.<ref name="Concept2" /> The dark entity [[Sel-Makor]] also resided in the Nightmare Lands, within an underground temple known as the [[Dark Heart]]. As long as the fighting between the Gormak and the Voss continued, the Nightmare Lands could have continued to expand and could have eventually covered Voss. A [[Lake of the Unseen|lake]] in the region's Northwest area contained a small island with a meditation shrine and tablet. The Voss Mystics often meditated here to increase their focus in entering the [[Spirit World]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightmare Lands were first mentioned on the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [http://www.swtor.com media website] along with concept art for the planet Voss.<ref name="Concept2" />
